description.value: Café 97 is a roadside cafe at Azouzetta Lake Lodge, tucked into the Pine Pass along Highway 97 near Powder King Mountain Resort in Northern BC. It serves homemade comfort food — burgers, baked goods, and donuts — and bills itself as offering the best customer service in the Pine Pass. For a touring cyclist grinding through a remote stretch of Hwy 97, it is one of the very few food stops in this corridor.

address.value: Mile 122, John Hart Hwy, Fraser-Fort George G, BC V0J 2C0, Canada
